# Fix R conda library

**Problem:** 

On the HPC, R often tries to install packages into ~/R/library (user library) or a system path like /opt/R/... instead of my conda env R4. This happens because R_LIBS_USER defaults to ~/R/library and/or site configs prepend system libraries. If I deleted ~/R, packages “disappear” because they were never in the conda env.

**Goal:**
Force R to install and load packages from the active conda environment:

$CONDA_PREFIX/lib/R/library

Conda activate R4 # in the console

Then inside R:

Sys.setenv(R_LIBS_USER = file.path(Sys.getenv("CONDA_PREFIX"), "lib", "R", "library"))
.libPaths(c(Sys.getenv("R_LIBS_USER"), .libPaths()))
Sys.getenv("R_LIBS_USER")
.libPaths()

#now you can do: 
install.packages("lol")
